title: Asking questions
summary: What, how, why, who, which: asking about things

sentences.en: How much does a map cost?
Do I need to book in advance?
Can you write that down, please?
Can you say it another way?

sentences.es: Perdone, no le he entendido bien.

sentences.en: What do people usually do on Sundays?
sentences.es: ¿Qué suele hacer la gente los domingos?
sentences.pt: O que é que as pessoas costumam fazer ao domingo?

sentences.en: Where do locals go out at night?
sentences.es: ¿Dónde sale de noche la gente de aquí?
sentences.pt: Onde é que as pessoas daqui saem à noite?

sentences.en: Is there a festival this week?
What would you do here with just one day?
sentences.es: ¿Qué haría usted aquí en un solo día?
sentences.pt: O que faria aqui num só dia?

passages.text: Esta máquina es para recargar la tarjeta de transporte. Primero eliges el idioma, luego pones la tarjeta aquí encima y pagas. Si te da error, pregunta en la ventanilla, que está abierta hasta las diez.
passages.en: This machine is for topping up the transport card. First you choose the language, then you put the card on top here and pay. If you get an error, ask at the counter, which is open until ten.
passages.question: What is the machine for, and what if it fails?
passages.answer: Topping up a transport card. If it fails, ask at the counter (open until ten).
wrong: Buying concert tickets. If it fails, call a phone number.
Taking out cash. If it fails, come back after ten.
Printing receipts. If it fails, ask the police.

passages.text: Esta máquina é para carregar o cartão de transportes. Primeiro escolhe a língua, depois põe o cartão aqui em cima e paga. Se der erro, pergunte na bilheteira, que está aberta até às dez.
passages.en: This machine is for topping up the transport card. First choose the language, then put the card on top here and pay. If you get an error, ask at the ticket office, which is open until ten.
passages.question: What is the machine for, and what if it fails?
passages.answer: Topping up a transport card. If it fails, ask at the ticket office (open until ten).
wrong: Buying concert tickets. If it fails, call a phone number.

Printing receipts. If it fails, ask the police.

passages.text: La oficina de turismo abre de diez a dos y de cuatro a siete. El mapa es gratis, pero las visitas guiadas hay que reservarlas al menos un día antes. Esta noche hay un concierto gratuito en la plaza.
passages.en: The tourist office opens from ten to two and from four to seven. The map is free, but guided tours must be booked at least a day ahead. Tonight there's a free concert in the square.
passages.question: What's happening tonight?
passages.answer: A free concert in the square.
wrong: A guided night tour.
The office stays open late.
A paid concert at the theatre.

passages.text: O posto de turismo abre das dez às duas e das quatro às sete. O mapa é grátis, mas as visitas guiadas têm de ser reservadas pelo menos com um dia de antecedência. Esta noite há um concerto gratuito na praça.

passages.text: No, no, el número es el de la calle, no el del edificio. Mire, se lo escribo: calle del Prado, número doce, segundo izquierda. Llama al timbre y le abren.
passages.en: No, no, the number is the street number, not the building. Look, I'll write it down for you: Prado Street, number twelve, second floor left. Ring the bell and they'll let you in.
passages.question: Where exactly do you need to go?
wrong: Number two, twelfth floor.
Building twelve, ground floor.
The second street on the left.

passages.text: Não, não, o número é o da rua, não o do prédio. Olhe, eu escrevo-lhe: rua do Prado, número doze, segundo esquerdo. Toca à campainha e abrem-lhe a porta.
passages.en: No, no, the number is the street number, not the building. Look, I'll write it down for you: Prado Street, number twelve, second floor left. Ring the bell and they'll let you in.
passages.question: Where exactly do you need to go?
wrong: Number two, twelfth floor.

passages.text: Aquí los domingos todo el mundo come en familia, y por la tarde se pasea por el parque. Si solo tiene un día, suba al castillo por la mañana, coma en el mercado y vea el atardecer desde el mirador.
passages.en: Here on Sundays everyone has lunch with family, and in the afternoon people stroll in the park. If you only have one day, go up to the castle in the morning, have lunch at the market and watch the sunset from the viewpoint.
passages.question: What's the one-day plan?
passages.answer: Castle in the morning, lunch at the market, sunset from the viewpoint.
wrong: Market in the morning, castle at sunset.
Lunch with a family, then the park.
Viewpoint at sunrise, then the beach.
